about.heroBody: The Lemi Kura Sub-City Construction Office is the government body responsible for planning, overseeing, and delivering all public infrastructure projects within Lemi Kura Sub-City, Addis Ababa.
about.visionBody: To ensure service accessibility by constructing quality standard public service institutions using modern and competitive construction industries, inputs, and technologies — involving the community — so that we become competitive with middle-income cities by the early 2020s.
about.missionPoint1: Based on the needs of sub-city residents, ensure that government-funded public service institutions are constructed to standard and deliver appropriate services to the public.
about.missionPoint2: Create within the institution a force that firmly combats corrupt practices and attitudes that hinder citizens from benefiting from national development in peace and security.
about.missionPoint3: Identify pressing good-governance challenges of the public and, in coordination with relevant stakeholders, resolve them and ensure fairness.
about.value1Body: Creating conditions where all parties can access information through technology-assisted operational transparency.
about.value2Body: Establishing a system where leaders, implementers, and professionals carry out responsibilities with ownership and are held accountable when they fall short.
about.value3Body: Ensuring that all constructed facilities guarantee the benefit and accessibility of all segments of society.
about.value4Body: Building a technology-capable workforce that understands the mission and can serve community needs with initiative.
about.value5Body: Using construction methods that embrace new technology to achieve high quality while being cost-efficient.
about.value6Body: Providing fast, customer-focused service and appropriate responses based on client needs.
about.value7Body: Ensuring safety is prioritized both at construction sites and when handing over completed facilities to users.
about.directorQuote: We will always strive to ensure community benefit, enhance public satisfaction, and elevate institutional services to a higher level of excellence.
about.teamBody: Our dedicated team of professionals works tirelessly to plan, supervise, and deliver public infrastructure projects that serve every resident of Lemi Kura Sub-City.
about.memberQuote1: We strive continuously to ensure community benefit, enhance public satisfaction, and achieve comprehensive improvement in institutional service delivery.
about.memberQuote2: Working round the clock, we strengthen coordination between leadership and staff to complete construction projects with quality and speed.
about.memberQuote3: Maintaining the level of construction quality we have achieved, we serve with commitment to improve the construction of trans-generational social service institutions.
about.memberQuote4: By preparing contemporary designs and providing adequate monitoring and support, we work with stakeholders to ensure government institution construction is high-quality and modern.
about.memberQuote5: We work to ensure institutional transparency and accountability, adhering to government construction guidelines, to guarantee service accessibility for all residents.
about.mandateTitle: What We Are Authorized To Do
about.mandate1: Plan and design public infrastructure across all sectors
about.mandate2: Oversee and supervise all construction projects
about.mandate3: Manage public procurement and tender processes
about.mandate5: Maintain and upgrade existing public facilities
about.mandate6: Coordinate with sub-city administrations and woreda offices
about.ctaBody: Reach out to our office directly — we respond within 2 business days.
about.member4RoleEn: Project Study & Design Preparation Team Leader
